The scene then shifts to show one of the staff members preparing a metal pet carrier, indicating the next step in the pet's service, likely for transport or a post-grooming rest.

In a professional pet grooming salon, a large golden retriever stands patiently on a grooming table while two groomers work on its coat. One groomer, wearing a patterned uniform, prepares a tool, while the other, in a dark shirt, begins to brush the dog’s back. In a busy pet grooming salon, a large, calm golden retriever is gently handled by a groomer as she prepares to work on its coat, while another staff member in patterned scrubs observes. The consistent setting and focused grooming actions highlight the professional, hands-on care provided at the pet spa.
